A '''salt water converter''' was a device capable of converting [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Water/Legends|water]] into potable drinking water. [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] were known to try and sell them on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Rancor" />
